- TOTAL revenue TW was £109.2k versus LW £88.2k, a WoW increase of 23.8%, and versus LY £50.4k, a YoY increase of 116.5%.

- CHILLI LIGHTS posted £2,285.12 TW revenue with a 2.1% share, closely followed by PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS at £2,264.16 also at 2.1% share.
- JUMBO BAG PAISLEY PARK recorded £2,120.48 TW revenue, a 1.9% share of total sales.
- FLOWERS CHANDELIER T-LIGHT HOLDER saw a WoW revenue increase of 9,231.2%, while TRADITIONAL NAUGHTS & CROSSES rose 2,400.0% WoW.
- CHRISTMAS CRAFT WHITE FAIRY achieved a YoY revenue increase of 28,727.6%, with RED HARMONICA IN BOX up 11,954.9% YoY and BROCADE RING PURSE up 6,587.3% YoY.
